biggest_catch: Requires parking $10,000 daily for 90 days plus 3 electronic credits; the $3 monthly maintenance fee applies unless you keep a $250 minimum daily balance. Maximum $200 savings bonus per household - and the household caps are separate ($350 checking + $200 savings = up to $550 combined per household).
catches: Open a new Statement Savings account with $10,000 or more (must not have had an open personal Newtown Savings Bank Statement Savings account within 12 months); use promo code SAVINGS.
Maintain the $10,000 balance daily for a period of 90 days.
Receive 3 electronic credits (ACH/Direct Deposit, Round-Up Savings, Mobile Check Deposit; does not include Zelle, Venmo or Cash App) within 90 days of opening the account.
Bonus is credited to the Statement Savings account on the month-end following the 90-day period; if the balance is negative on or before the month-end following the 90 days, the bonus is not paid.
Maximum $200 bonus per household; estate and political campaign accounts not eligible.
$3 monthly maintenance service charge applies unless a $250 minimum daily balance is kept.
Bonus is taxable income; offer subject to change and may be withdrawn at any time.
A lesser $75 tier exists (open with $750+, maintain daily for 90 days + 3 electronic credits) - officially confirmed but not separately verified in this row.
